skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Sends out a recon drone to scout a single target, causing the ally with the highest ATK to perform a [Follow-Up]. Restores own HP equal to 120% ATK.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies, dealing 110% ATK DMG. Reduces their Max HP by 15% for 2 turns. Any HP exceeding the reduced Max HP is immediately removed.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies, dealing 140% ATK DMG. Reduces their Max HP by 15% for 2 turns. Any HP exceeding the reduced Max HP is immediately removed.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. At battle start, increases all allies' Max HP by 15% for 2 turns. When a Monster ally is in the same column, Gyoro-Gyoro shares 50% of the DMG received by that ally. DMG Sharing stops when the ally's HP falls below 20%.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. At battle start, increases all allies' Max HP for 2 turns. When a Monster ally is in the same column, Gyoro-Gyoro shares 50% of the DMG received by that ally. DMG Sharing stops when the ally's HP falls below 20%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. At battle start, increases all allies' Max HP by 25% for 2 turns. When a Monster ally is in the same column, Gyoro-Gyoro shares 50% of the DMG received by that ally. DMG Sharing stops when the ally's HP falls below 20%.

effects.desc: An additional attack performed by the ally with the highest ATK when triggered by Gyoro-Gyoro's Basic Attack.
Gyoro-Gyoro shares 50% of the DMG received by a Monster ally in the same column. The effect stops when that ally's HP falls below 20%.
